jobText:
Role: Staff / Principal Cloud Architect
Location: Seattle, WA (Flexible Hybrid / Remote)

Position Summary:
We are seeking a seasoned Principal Cloud Architect to establish the technical foundation for our enterprise distributed platform. You will steer technical roadmaps, define architectural governance, and partner with executive engineering leadership on mission-critical initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
- Architect highly scalable, multi-region distributed cloud systems supporting hundreds of millions of daily user transactions.
- Champion architectural best practices, author technical RFCs, and lead Architecture Review Board sessions.
- Optimize enterprise cloud economics, driving FinOps practices to maximize efficiency and reduce compute waste.
- Provide deep mentorship to staff and senior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence.

Required Background:
- 10+ years of software engineering and systems architecture experience.
- Extensive experience with distributed systems design, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and event streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Kinesis).
- Proven background in Go, Java, or C++ in high-scale production environments.
- Demonstrated ability to translate complex business objectives into resilient, observable technical systems.
- Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science or equivalent hands-on industry track record.
